scope: Unpublished bootstrap cleanup after private root loss; current rebased public NTLM/Kerberos, cancellation and lease-isolation profiles. Full feature/G0 acceptance remains incomplete.

change.production: Four existing availability/terminal-state predicates distinguish a bootstrap awaiting canonical handoff. Published sessions retain last-channel fencing; pending bootstrap cleanup can bind once more without prematurely stopping its executor.
change.tests: Two new parameterized root-loss recovery cases fail before the fix and pass after it. One new handoff case preserves published-session last-channel fencing.
change.provenance: CUSTOM adaptation to existing G0/bootstrap and development lifecycle integration. No external donor body imported or replaced.
